_comment: Dynamic two-state smFRET with conformational exchange. Same two FRET states as proximity_ratio.json, now interconverting via the SPONTANEOUS rate matrix k_nrad (row-major i->j, per macro-time/ms unit): 0->1 and 1->0 both at 2 ms^-1. Exchange on the timescale of a burst (~0.1-1 ms) shifts each burst toward the time-averaged ratio, bridging the two static peaks. Compare the histogram against proximity_ratio.json.
